snippet.title: Steel Carnelian: Pilot Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Download the free pilot episode here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3060340/Steel_Carnelian/

Steel Carnelian is a fixed-camera 3D run-and-gun.  Take control of Cass Harrison and her mech suit, the Spirit-47, as she tackles the most dangerous job of her career.
